change_summary: Replaced hardcoded grid tuple `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128), triton.cdiv(ynumel, 8))` with a lambda `lambda META: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, META['XBLOCK']), triton.cdiv(ynumel, META['YBLOCK']))` in kernel_function() so that @triton.autotune can actually benchmark all 10 configs and select the optimal tile shape instead of always running with XBLOCK=128, YBLOCK=8.
